short: Standard: first CTC and Transformer lip readers side by side on LRS2, but objective and architecture are confounded and runs single; online decoding lacks partial-hypothesis accuracy and ms delay.
position: M06 and M13 changed. M06 standard: BLSTM-CTC, depthwise temporal-convolution CTC and Transformer seq2seq on one front end; none of the 49 earlier decoders mentions a Transformer and the ledger has no earlier CTC-versus-attention comparison on one front end (Appendix), but objective is confounded with architecture (on one Transformer encoder the concurrent TPAMI paper gets 54.7% with CTC and 48.3% with attention), by CER FC-15 equals the Transformer (33.9% vs 34.0%), and each model is trained once. M13 not reported: the online FC decoder lags 22 or 32 frames (0.88 or 1.28 s at 25 fps) and its final output equals the offline one, but partial-hypothesis accuracy, delay in ms and beam-search cost are not given; before the target 2 of 4 online decoders, both Cai et al. 2011, report real-time factors. M07 standard: the non-public T2 LM gains 0.7-1.3 points; TM's T1 has no external LM. M12 not reported: 70.4% is credited to MV-WAS in Table 1 and to WLAS in Sec. 3.3 with no conditions and unresolved training data; 'over 20' holds as points only with T2 and as relative change with T1 (27%); single runs.
